description: This file defines a PHP function 'additionalDetailsAccount' that generates an HTML snippet with account billing address and contact details, likely used for display overlays or tooltips within the Accounts module of a CRM system. It also includes licensing and copyright information for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: additionalDetailsAccount
methods.description: Generates an HTML snippet with billing address and contact info for an account, returning details such as address, fax, phone, website, industry, and description, formatted for display.
